title: Add filesystem exploration commands
description:
Allow basic shell commands like ls, find, pwd to help the agent navigate the filesystem when file paths are unclear. Currently only git, mvn, pytest, pyright, black, hugo, prettier, uv run python, gh pr, gh auth are allowed - adding ls would prevent the agent from getting stuck trying to read files it can't locate.
